summary: Tells the build to run Tailwind and Autoprefixer over the stylesheets.
purpose: Makes the styling system work when the app is built.
why: Likely reason: Tailwind needs this step to generate the CSS classes the app uses. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Lists two plugins, Tailwind and Autoprefixer, which the build runs in order.
inputs: Stylesheets and Tailwind class names in the code.
outputs: Finished CSS with browser prefixes added.
risks: If a plugin is removed, styles can disappear without an error.
